draft.title: The Glass Wardens
draft.description: Guide three glass wardens through deterministic tactical card battles, five branching expedition steps and a two-phase lighthouse boss. EN/FR/ES, touch controls and exact local save.
controls: Click or tap a hero or card, then a highlighted target; review and confirm or cancel.
Each hero moves once; spend three shared energy, then end turn.
Escape cancels, Space ends turn, M toggles sound.
